statement: Let Efr, Bfr be the homogeneous wave solutions with data (Efr , ∂tEfr )|t=0 = (E0, ∇ × B0), (Bfr , ∂tBfr )|t=0 = (B0, −∇ × E0). For t > 0, define initial boundary terms by (Ebd , Bbd )(t, x) = 1 4πt ∫ |x−y0|=t ∫ R3 f0(y0, v0) d0 ( n0 − u0, n0 × (n0 − u0) ) dv0 dSy0 , n0 = (x − y0)/t, u0 = u(v0), d0 = 1 − n0 · u0. (3.8) Set these terms to zero at t = 0. Then E(t, x) = Efr (t, x) + Ebd (t, x) + 1 4π ∫ Lt,x f0(z) K dz, B(t, x) = Bfr (t, x) + Bbd (t, x) + 1 4π ∫ Lt,x f0(z) (n × K ) dz, (3.9) 9 where K = n − u r2q2d3 + (n − u)(n · b) − db rd3 . (3.10) All these integrals are well defined at the stated classical regularity. Moreover, sup 0≤t≤T0, x∈R3 (|Efr | + |Bfr | + |Ebd | + |Bbd |) ≤ CT0,f0,E0,B0 . (3.11)
